text:
Fixed the parameter processing order in `iter_params_for_processing`.

Root cause: sorting prioritized command-line invocation order before eagerness, so invalid options could be processed before `--help`, `--version`, or other eager options.

Change: eager parameters are now always processed before non-eager parameters, while preserving invocation order within each group.

final_text:
Fixed the parameter processing order in `iter_params_for_processing`.

Root cause: sorting prioritized command-line invocation order before eagerness, so invalid options could be processed before `--help`, `--version`, or other eager options.

Change: eager parameters are now always processed before non-eager parameters, while preserving invocation order within each group.
